Stock

Every product's stock quantity in one place — set or adjust it here; leave blank to stop tracking stock for that item.

Stock Ready (in Factory)

Confirmed factory orders that haven't been received yet — once you attach the gate receipt, the order drops off this list.

Raw Material Stock

Computed automatically — raw material received (from the Raw Material Ledger) minus what's been used by every order booked, by material name. Set a Low Stock threshold per material to get flagged when it's running low.

Product Stock (On Hand)

Every product's stock quantity and Low Stock Alert Level in one place — set or adjust either here; leave blank to stop tracking that item.

Scrap Stock

Total scrap weight sold and payments received across every buyer, from the Scrap Ledger.

Backup & Restore

Save a copy of everything on this device, or restore from a previous backup.

Signature & Stamp
Your stamp with signature is added automatically to the signature line on every PDF and image export (Customer/Factory Ledger, Transactions, Paint/Raw Material/Custom/Labour Ledgers, Expenses, Inventory). Upload a new photo any time to replace it.
No signature/stamp
Create a backup
Saves all sales, inventory, ledgers, expenses, and settings on this device into one file you can keep safe or move to another device.
Restore from Backup
Choose a backup file to bring back everything it contains. This replaces what's on this device and pushes that data up to your shared Google Sheet — every other device will pick it up on its next sync. This cannot be undone.
Auto Backup
Automatically saves a backup on its own on this schedule — no need to tap Create Backup yourself. This only runs while the app is open (it checks every minute), so if the app's been closed longer than the interval, it just catches up with one backup as soon as you open it again — it can't run while the app or your phone is fully closed/locked.
Send a copy to Gmail
Opens Android's share screen with a fresh backup file attached — pick Gmail and send it to yourself (or anyone) so a copy lives off this device too.

Change PIN

PIN updated.

Security Question
Used by "Forgot PIN?" on the lock screen to let you reset your PIN without losing access. Question: "What is the shop owner's name?" — enter your current PIN to change the saved answer.

Security answer updated.

Auto-Lock
Automatically show the PIN lock screen after the app has been idle or minimized for this long — protects your ledger if the phone is left unattended.
Google Sign-In & Lock Screen
The lock screen now unlocks with your Google account instead of a PIN. Turn on fingerprint below for a faster day-to-day unlock — you'll still confirm with Google the first time on a device, or whenever fingerprint isn't available.

Quick Help

1. Pick a category from the sidebar, or search, then tap a product to add it to the invoice.

2. Adjust quantity with − / + or remove a line with ✕ in the invoice.

3. Tap Add to record the sale and print a receipt. Set how it was paid — Cash, Bank, or Online Transfer — from the Transactions list.

4. Use Lock Screen to secure the till between customers.
